    (And
      (∀ (j : Fin (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} k 1)),
        LT.lt.{0} 0 ↑j → LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Research.TriangularUpdate.ErrorTrace.addError e j)) u)
      (And (LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Research.TriangularUpdate.ErrorTrace.subError e)) u)

fun {k} a b e x =>
  Nat.brecOn.{1} x fun x f =>
    (match (motive := (x : Nat) → Nat.below.{1} x → Real) x with
      | 0 => fun x => 0
      | Nat.succ n => fun x =>
        if h : LT.lt.{0} n (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} k 1) then
          ite.{1} (Eq.{1} n 0) (Research.TriangularUpdate.roundedProduct a b e ⟨n, h⟩)
            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} x.1 (Research.TriangularUpdate.roundedProduct a b e ⟨n, h⟩))
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} 1 (Research.TriangularUpdate.ErrorTrace.addError e ⟨n, h⟩)))
        else x.1)
      f

declarations.name: Research.TriangularUpdate.triangular_update
declarations.type:
∀ (k : Nat) (hk : LE.le.{0} 2 k) (u : Real),
  LE.le.{0} 0 u →
    LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑k) u) 1 →
      ∀ (a b : Fin k → Real) (c : Real),
        Ne.{1} (b (Research.TriangularUpdate.lastIndex k hk)) 0 →
          ∀ (e : Research.TriangularUpdate.ErrorTrace k),
            Research.TriangularUpdate.ErrorTrace.Valid e u →
              And
                (Eq.{1}
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                    (∑ i,
                      HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (a (Research.TriangularUpdate.prefixIndex i))
                        (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (b (Research.TriangularUpdate.prefixIndex i))
                          (Research.TriangularUpdate.perturbation b e (Research.TriangularUpdate.prefixIndex i))))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.TriangularUpdate.computedUpdate hk a b c e)
                      (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (b (Research.TriangularUpdate.lastIndex k hk))
                        (Research.TriangularUpdate.perturbation b e (Research.TriangularUpdate.lastIndex k hk)))))
                  c)
                (∀ (i : Fin k),
                  LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Research.TriangularUpdate.perturbation b e i))
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Research.TriangularUpdate.gamma k u) (abs.{0} (b i))))
